title: Chapter 248 - 248 No One Believes The Truth; Head To The Office!

Chapter 248 - 248 No One Believes The Truth; Head To The Office!

Chapter 248 - 248 No One Believes the Truth; Head to the Office!

248 No One Believes the Truth; Head to the Office!

Lin Fan chatted with Lu Lin for a while before strolling back to the dormitory.

“Brother Lin Fan, you’re finally here! I missed you so much!” Song Yi was the first to shout excitedly.

After saying that, he opened his arms and looked like he wanted to hug Lin Fan.

Lin Fan waved his hands. “Forget about hugging. I only hug beautiful women.”

Zheng Jinbao, who was sitting in front of the computer, heard the word ‘beautiful’, and his eyes lit up. He chuckled and said, “Brother Lin Fan, which pretty girl did you go out with these past few days?”

Lin Fan laughed bitterly and said, “I went to earn money from DiDi. I have no choice. Life isn’t easy!”

Zheng Jinbao directly filtered out the words ‘life is not easy.’

He widened his eyes and asked excitedly, “F*ck, awesome!” Brother Lin Fan, tell me. How many pretty girls did you meet?”

Obviously, he felt that Lin Fan had driven his supercar.

How could ordinary beauties resist the temptation of a supercar?

Lin Fan saw through Zheng Jinbao’s thoughts at a glance and said, “What are you thinking about? I didn’t use a supercar.”

“What?” Zheng Jinbao was confused.

At this moment, the sound of brisk footsteps could be heard from outside.

Ma Zhong carried a stack of books and slowly walked in.

“Brother Lin Fan, you’re back!” Ma Zhong said happily.

Lin Fan nodded. “Yeah.”

Then, Ma Zhong took out his phone and said, “Oh right, when I passed by the parking lot just now, I saw a Rolls-Royce parked in our school!”

Almost all men loved cars.

The Rolls-Royce was the king of cars.

When Song Yi and Zheng Jinbao heard this, they leaned their heads over.

“It’s a Rolls-Royce Phantom!” Song Yi shouted.

Lin Fan smiled casually, “If you want to see, you can go over and take a look.”

As he spoke, he placed the Rolls-Royce Phantom keys in his pocket on the table.

Silence.

He was most afraid of a sudden silence.

After a while, Song Yi stuttered, “B-Brother Lin Fan, is the Rolls-Royce Phantom yours too?”

“Yes, it is,” Lin Fan said.

Lin Fan already owned several supercars, yet he had a Rolls-Royce Phantom now?

Zheng Jinbao, Song Yi, and Ma Zhong shouted in unison, “Brother Lin Fan, you’re awesome!”

At this moment, Zheng Jinbao seemed to have thought of something and asked, “Brother Lin Fan, don’t tell me you drove the Phantom when you were driving through DiDi?”

As he spoke, he could not help but think of the scene when the passengers sat in the Rolls-Royce Phantom and were dumbfounded.

“I drove the Santana… However, I earned this Rolls-Royce Phantom by driving through DiDi,” Lin Fan said.

“Brother Lin Fan, do you think I’m stupid?” Zheng Jinbao said.

Was that not so?

A Rolls-Royce Phantom cost ten million.

DiDi?

Even if he drove to his death, he would definitely not be able to earn that kind of money.

Lin Fan smiled and shook his head.

In fact…

Lin Fan did not just earn a Rolls-Royce Phantom from DiDi. He had earned ten cars from it!

In addition, there was ten million in cash and 5% of Penguin Group’s shares!

Sometimes, the truth was hard to believe.

When a group of young people were together, time seemed to slip away like sand in their palms.

Soon, the bell rang.

Lin Fan, Zheng Jinbao, Ma Zhong, Song Yi, and the others had already arrived at the classroom.

They were not the only ones. There were many others who had similar actions.

There was no empty seat in the classroom.

It was because this was Teacher Tiantian’s class.

Following the sound of crisp footsteps, Teacher Tiantian, who was wearing a pure white short skirt and a light gray windbreaker, walked to the podium.

Instantly, the entire classroom fell silent.

Teacher Tiantian first looked at the students in the classroom. When she saw Lin Fan, her pretty face could not help but reveal a faint smile.

This smile…

Like the rising sun in the winter, everyone’s hearts almost melted.

Then, Teacher Tiantian began today’s class.

Usually, when a teacher gave a lecture, most of the students would fall asleep and wish that the class would end in a second.

However, Teacher Tiantian’s class was the complete opposite.

After the bell rang, many students began to complain.

“Why is class over so soon?”

“Yeah!”

However, no matter how much they complained…

There would be no change in the time of the end of class.

When Teacher Tiantian was about to leave the classroom, she suddenly stopped and said, “Lin Fan, come to my office after school.”

After saying that, she continued to walk out.

Instantly, all the students in the classroom looked at Lin Fan with envy.

Teacher Tiantian’s invitation!

Moreover, this was not the first time!

Song Yi, Ma Zhong, and Zheng Jinbao shouted in unison, “Brother Fan, I’ll kneel before you!”

After saying that, they really did bend their knees slightly as if they were about to kneel.

Lin Fan looked at their funny faces and wanted to laugh.

…

Lin Fan had been to Teacher Tiantian’s office several times and was now very familiar with it.

At this moment, Teacher Tiantian was the only one in the office.

The quiet office and Teacher Tiantian, who was writing at her desk, formed a beautiful picture.

When Teacher Tiantian heard the footsteps, she slowly raised her head. When she saw that it was Lin Fan, she could not help but smile. “Do you want something to drink?”

“I’m a little thirsty,” Lin Fan said.

After saying that, he did not treat himself as an outsider. He directly picked up the cup that Teacher Tiantian had just drunk from and started drinking it.

After all, with their relationship, there was no need for formalities.

After Lin Fan drank the water, he looked at the calculations on Teacher Tiantian’s desk and said, “Are you still studying the Hail Conjecture? Hmm? There seems to be a problem here.”

“Where?” Teacher Tiantian asked.

Lin Fan pointed at a formula. Then, he picked up a pen and paper and started writing.

2^m-3^（n+1）>1m>n,2^m>3^（m+)…

“Forget it. I’ll just write down the entire process,” Lin Fan said.

Teacher Tiantian, who was sitting next to her, was stunned.

Write down the entire process?

Lin Fan picked up a new stack of draft paper.

X1=3,X2=（3×1+1）2^2=1…

Lin Fan’s writing speed was very fast. He did not think at all. The tip of the pen collided with the draft paper, making light and hurried sounds.

At first, Teacher Tiantian was still looking down at Lin Fan’s handwriting seriously.

However, as time passed…

Gradually, Teacher Tiantian could not keep up even if she just watched.

Then, Teacher Tiantian could not help but shift her gaze from the draft book to Lin Fan.

She looked at Lin Fan’s quick writing of the formula and his focused expression…

At this moment…

In Teacher Tiantian’s eyes, Lin Fan did not seem to be writing down formulas. Instead, he was sitting on a gorgeous stage, gathering dazzling stage lights on himself while playing a beautiful piece of music.

Teacher Tiantian’s heart beat faster and faster as the rhythm of the movement rose and fell…
